rows.text: Achieved total Company third quarter net income 1 of $32.0 million, or $0.61 per diluted share, and Adjusted EBITDA, excluding LIFO 2 of $115.0 million, exceeding guidance of $88 to $92 million.
Net income generation for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to be in the range of $16 to $20 million, or $0.30 to $0.38 per diluted share, with LIFO expense between $28 and $32 million.
